name: trade-auditor
track: 02 - The Agent That Can Explain Why
challenge_question: Why did this trade pass or fail my system?

sponsor_tech.zetaris: Data layer. All journal lookups (trades + notes, joined) go through Zetaris as the data harness; the agent never reads journal files directly. Local CSV reader with the identical contract is the fallback until the instance is provisioned (see src/auditor/data_pipe.py).
sponsor_tech.meterless: Engine pattern. Meterless publishes its engines (World State, Memory, Reasoning, Intent, Swarm) as a local-first, prompt-based context-layer pattern with a Context Packet structure — no SDK; builders recreate the pattern in their own stack. Recreated here in Python (src/auditor/context_packet.py): World State = the day's declared frame + running state; Memory = the journal row + day history every claim must cite; Reasoning = rule evaluation; Intent = the one question and its guardrails; Swarm = Planner / Executor / Evaluator working one packet in sequence.
sponsor_tech.cursor: Build layer. Project built in Cursor; git history is the build log.
